test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Income of Amit in 2019 was ₹22,000. He gets an increment of 20% every year. What was his income (in ₹) in 2021?
solution:
**Given:**

Income in 2019 = ₹22,000

Increment per year = 20%

Time = 2 years (2021 - 2019)

**Formula used:**

Income = Initial Income × (1 + Increment Rate)Years

**Calculation:**

Income = 22000 × (1 + 20/100)²

⇒ Income = 22000 × (1 + 0.2)²

⇒ Income = 22000 × 1.2²

⇒ Income = 22000 × 1.44

⇒ Income = ₹31,680

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
